Give the epoch a backbone: Stone polisher polished agate warrant faceted in the faceting bench, proved by each polished agate is a year of stone logs in the lapidary ledger, checked by strangers. One cedar is a pass, one ferrous is a fare, one saffron is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. No single office can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three separate keepers.
